title: Privacy
description: Your data, what you agreed to, and deleting your account.
impersonating: While acting as someone, their data, consents and account deletion stay theirs.

export.title: Export your data
export.description: A copy of everything held about you: your account, then what each organization you belong to holds about you. The file is made in the background.
export.kept: The exports started in this browser. A finished export is kept 7 days; its download link works 30 minutes, open this page again for a new one.

consents.title: Consents
consents.description: What you agreed to, and when. Each is kept as proof.
consents.outdated: You accepted version {{version}} on {{date}}; version {{current}} is current.
consents.locked: Required to use the app: it can't be withdrawn here.
consents.withdrawable: You can withdraw it at any time.
consents.withdrawnAt: Withdrawn {{date}}. Switch it on to give it again.

deletion.title: Delete your account
deletion.description: This can't be undone once it is carried out.
deletion.grace: Your account is deleted after a grace period; the email we send says the date. Until then you stay signed in and can cancel, here or with the email's link, even without signing in.
deletion.erased: Then your name and email address are replaced, and your password, sign-in methods, sessions, memberships, notifications and settings are removed, in every organization you belong to.
deletion.keptRecords: Records you created stay with their organization, no longer linked to you.
deletion.audit: The audit log keeps its entries, labelled "Deleted user".
deletion.exportFirst: Export your data first if you want a copy.
deletion.confirmDescription: To confirm, type your email address and your password.
deletion.confirmMismatch: This is not your account's address.
deletion.passwordHint: Leave empty if your account has no password.
deletion.mailHint: We'll email you the date and a link to cancel.
deletion.requested: Your account will be deleted on {{date}}. We emailed {{email}} a link to cancel.
deletion.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on {{date}}.
deletion.scheduledHint: We emailed {{email}} a link to cancel it, which works without signing in. Or keep your account here.
deletion.kept: The deletion is cancelled: your account stays.
